The correct strategy is to sum all steps in one direction (Left: 10 + 1 = 11) and all steps in the opposite direction (Right: 7 + 4 = 11). Since the net displacement is 11 - 11 = 0, the answer is "Yes". Next time, I will explicitly calculate the total steps for each opposing direction pair before determining if the net result is zero, ensuring I account for every individual step instruction rather than grouping them prematurely.
